• Serve as the primary point of contact for customers through onboarding and implementation

  • Deliver implementations on time, keeping customer teams up and running against agreed milestones

  • Own delivery of Acme's AI Agents (Research, Revenue, Personalization, Deal, and Meeting Prep) from configuration and prompt engineering through adoption

  • Demonstrate project management excellence: keep stakeholders on track, stay within budget and margin, manage risk, and secure customer sign-off at project completion

  • Support existing customers who purchase additional services post-launch, including optimizations, technical audits, and expansions

  • Identify opportunities for additional services, including Managed Services, and connect customers with the right teams to scope

  • Document and manage customer information so handoffs between teams and resources are seamless

  • Own the post-launch handoff of customers to Customer Success

  • Partner with Support, Product, and Engineering to capture customer feedback and see it through

  • Contribute to defining and refining Professional Services methodologies, assets, and programs, including how AI is embedded into our delivery workflows

  • Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target

lists.content:
• Acting as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders (CROs, COOs, CTOs, VPs of RevOps, etc.), influencing vision and technical direction for enterprise customers. 
  • Owning the technical strategy for high-value, multi-threaded deals, driving discovery, solution design, and value articulation aligned to customer initiatives. 
  • Leading engaging, outcome-based demonstrations and Proof of Value (POV) engagements that connect Acme’s capabilities to business outcomes. 
  • Partnering with AEs to craft win strategies using MEDDPICC, Demo2Win, and value-selling frameworks. 
  • Translating complex business processes into scalable, ROI-driven solutions and clearly articulating “the art of the possible” through Acme’s platform and AI agents (Boost, Assist, Research Agent). 
  • Building credibility as a subject matter expert in revenue execution, pipeline management, and AI innovation. 
  • Acting as a mentor and deal coach to Solutions Consultants, providing feedback and guidance on demo execution, discovery, and strategic selling. 
  • Collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Enablement to influence roadmap priorities and build differentiated enterprise narratives. 
  • Creating and maintaining scalable demo and POV assets, vertical playbooks, and industry-specific solution stories. 
  • Representing Acme as a thought leader through webinars, customer roundtables, and industry events.
